notes.title: Mega Update1.4.0
notes.notes:
Greetings Recruits.

Today is a very special day because during these 2 months I have focused on improving the gaming experience in terms of the feedback received during all this time
And I have prepared a very complete update for the game that I hope you like, as it was a couple of months of hard work. Without further ado we are going to start with the news of
This version 1.4.0

[h1]-Artistic Section.[/h1]

I've improved the backgrounds and tiles to give a darker feel than what I originally had in mind by removing a bit of unnecessary brightness as well as highlighting.
Playable elements such as bigger and more showy bullets as well as changing some of the victory images improving them.

[h1]-New dialog box[/h1]

Now you will find better dialogue boxes prior to facing the bosses of the game that include an image of who is speaking in the dialogue.

[h1]-Interface [/h1]

The button customization section has been resolved and improved in which now both the keyboard and the controller work independently, therefore
The configuration of your keyboard will remain intact even if you change the configuration of the controller and vice versa, in addition, now by pressing ESC you can cancel the configuration in case of regret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/5eede29b2e7b83e3a11fe4d034165391369319d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/9aac4f8c0d5ed38a6a89f134301d6d04349fbdad.png[/img]

[h1] - Gamepad default remapping [/h1]

The gamepad has been remapped to a more user-friendly standard configuration as can be seen in the following illustration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/d7d29642819605a44478d4ac072261c2eba52c0e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/4677c3cdbaa4e26318a88d480788043e5532cbc7.png[/img]

I open a paragraph because the most important changes are coming to the game in consideration of the rest of the sections.

[h1]-Gameplay [/h1]
[h2]
- Improvement in the physics of the grenades. [/h2]

Now the grenades of the grenade launcher bounce in a more natural way which makes their handling easier.

[h2] - New friendly Drone system. [/h2]

Now in the boss rooms the continuous dropping of barrels, which caused bugs in the bosses, has been replaced by drones sent by Eiji to obtain
Weapons and drinks.

[h2]- More Permissive and Intelligent Bosses[/h2]

Bosses now have a fixed reaction time instead of a random one which made many players unable to guess their movement pattern besides now
They give the player time to react to their attacks.

[h2]- Movement reduction after falling. [/h2]

Now when falling off a cliff and respawning for a short period of time your speed is blocked and you will not fall continuously as before.

[h1]- New Melee Attack 
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/22ab0a00d8a6bdba21410dc10bee40fb7023e70e.png[/img]

Now you can perform melee attacks and the best thing is that you can do it in 2 ways thanks to the configuration menu where you can choose to do it in a
Standard or automatic.

The Automatic consists of making a melee attack while an enemy is quite close, pressing the fire button.

The Standard consists of performing the melee attack by pressing another independent and designated button no matter where the enemy is.

[h2]- New speed lock button[/h2]

The function of this button is to block the speed of the player to shoot in 8 different directions, that is to say that now you can shoot diagonally without moving from your place
Pressing that button.

[h2]- New Weapon Change[/h2]

Now when taking a new weapon, the player will drop the reserve one with the ammunition that you left it previously in case you want to recover it.

[h2]- New death counter [/h2]

Now at the end of the game you will be able to see how many times you have died in a game and share it with your friends.

[h2] -New warning system in mission 6 [/h2]

Now when there are obstacles on the road a warning will appear to have time to react before crashing into them

[h2]- 2 new achievements and ... an extra [/h2]

Accompanied by the new mechanics come new achievements in the game that consist of the following.

--- The knife goes in, the guts come out
--- Defying danger

You can see what they are by visiting the achievements section.

[h1]-Adjustments and Fixed Bugs [/h1]

- Now the boss collisions are smaller to avoid that the player has the feeling that he had not touched the boss and yet he has touched it in an area where there is no graphic.

- Player will no longer get stuck in moving barrels in zone 4-2

--The green drones and the helicopter can now shoot while on top of the player, before they were stopped without firing.

--Fixed a graph of the Sniper when the player was in the same vertical coordinate gave the sensation of still standing but shooting, now it already shows the graph of preparing the shot.

- Weapons: increased the ammunition of 2 weapons that required it (CTR15) from 120 to 160 and (RLT12) from 100 to 130.

And that's all I remember, maybe I made more changes but I don't remember them at the moment, I hope you enjoy this update, I tried very hard to bring these improvements to the game
Well, they are very notorious and there are several things that they have been asking me for.

Unfortunately due to lack of resources I cannot bring back the native version of Linux for now, hopefully later I can bring it back, for now that version will be deactivated so that
Future buyers are not disappointed.

See you next time.

notes.title: Update 1.3.0 and Discount for the Independence of Mexico
notes.notes:
Greetings Recruits!

Today is the day and I am pleased to announce for you this new update patch to version 1.3.0 which contains many changes and improvements which we will see below, also that we are celebrating the 210th anniversary of the Mexican independence movement which is the country this video game is inspired by, without further ado, let's get started.

[h1]Update 1.3.0 [/h1]

[h2]Changes in the Graphical aspect of Lore[/h2]

A job was done to remake the graphics of the game's cinematics to make them relate directly to the 16-bit aspect of the games of the time and leaving aside the appearance of graphics made in Paint, adding more detail to the colors and improving the look of the game in general.

[b]Lore Before:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/1b1d5c3c19eabc4f69cd7ff209a70cb7493d1e31.png[/img]

[b]Lore now:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/ced0a36f023736b479caf6bdf22543be6ea7e9c6.png[/img]

[h2]Changes in the Start menu[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/ed386fa5654a7a95ff02d6e3757a09a458213d99.png[/img]

Now the initial menu is composed as follows:

[b]-Start
-Options
-Exit [/b]

before it was:

[b]-New Game
-Options
-Exit [/b]

I did this to avoid confusion, because, thanks to the feedback, I knew that this confused the user by not knowing if their saved game was there or if it had been deleted.

Another change I made regarding that confusion is that now when I select Start, if there is a saved game, it will immediately ask you if you want to load that game.

[h2]New activatable platforms [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/40282353a11340160b0fc6bef16867c131386a4a.png[/img]

This is an aspect that many had asked for and that I have now been able to do more calmly, platforms that are activated only when you step on them, no longer waiting for platforms, but it will only be in specific cases, that is, when the section of a platform is too long or when the platforms were not syncing correctly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/767a6c9770c068a0b501fbc5eca5f76716814e8b.png[/img]

[h2]Reduced the difficulty of Queeny Army in easy mode[/h2]

Now the easy mode has been made much more accessible for the player so that if he plays in easy he can pass it really easily to what accompanies a balance to the enemies in this game mode, in addition to that level 1 has been redesigned to avoid deaths and unfair situations.

-Basic police, turrets, drones and Snipers 1 resistance point (no changes to brown police and pipers)
-Marines and SWAT 3 resistance points
-Black and white elite police 5 resistance points
-Bosses, resistance points reduced by half.

[h2]Downward diagonal shot [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/0a0821939225e8e1e718fcd281b0c15d5fa3e030.png[/img]

This is another aspect that has been asked of me so much, now you can shoot diagonally downwards which benefits weapons such as the sniper rifle and the shotgun that can go through walls.

[h2]New Achievement: Pineapples Prohibited[/h2]

This new achievement is accompanied by a new function of the game, now you can shoot the enemy grenades and make them explode in your favor.

the goal of the achievement is obvious and if you don't know it check out the Queeny Army achievements section

last but not least ...

[h2]Balance of Weapons[/h2]

In this balance I buffed a couple of weapons that required more power to kill the enemies

-M60

Damage per bullet increased from 1 unit to 2 units (visual appearance changes)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/fd6d10e55c4a6adac123cbba8c2512209c7f2b6d.png[/img]

-Tommy Gun (Fatima exclusive)

Damage per bullet increased from 1 unit to 2 units.

But wait! There's still more!

If your friends still don't have [b] Queeny Army [/ b] then call them because this interests them! In commemoration of the 210th anniversary of the Mexican independence movement, from this day until September 21 the game will have a 60% discount To celebrate Mexico together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/6994d66b6bba59a1a1770bed7175e5a3fd1c0750.png[/img]

And that's all for now, I hope you liked this update patch, see you until the next one, which will surely be much more impressive than this one, until then recruits!

notes.title: Queeny Army Update Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Greetings Recruits!

Today I am excited to announce that update 1.2.0 is already available and contains many changes that you are sure to love.

[h1]News [/h1]

First of all we will start with the lightest to go to the end with the most important changes, starting with the following.

[b]Aesthetic Changes[/b]

I have made aesthetic changes in some scenarios that I liked visually and decided to implement them in this version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/491236050e3aa3d61e803bf40ccf769a44c96c51.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/cba042e5c6e8aa60ea0c959aadba82434ef29f11.png[/img]

[b]Increased Framerate[/b]

Increased framerate from 45 to 50 FPS again

[b]New Dynamic Camera[/b]

Now by holding down the Up or Down button you can make the camera move down or up so you can see beyond what you could not see before.

[b]New AFK Animations[/b]

As a new aesthetic change I decided to implement the Away From Keyboard (AFK) animations which run 10 seconds after not pressing any button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/aa4739166934008fc8622f82a74787afecfcd13e.png[/img]

Each Girl has a different animation Except Gaby and Fatima, discover what they are.

[b]Bonuses at the end of the Mission[/b]

Now at the end of a mission you will receive 4 types of Score bonuses.

-Time bonus: the less late it takes to pass a higher level the bonus will be.
-No death bonus: If you did not die during the mission you will be rewarded
-Primary weapon bonus: If you finished the mission with a weapon other than the default
-Secondary Weapon Bonus: If you finished the mission with a reserve weapon.

Finally it is time to delight in the main course ...

[b]New Game Mode "Speedrun Mode"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/0da52908024c26c862a3430b493e95b73de35a1d.png[/img]

This new game mode will be unlocked at the end of the adventure for the first time in any difficulty mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/5bb799a56913fee80e00d0b1348e71eaed3280da.png[/img]

This mode is free of cinematic sequences and consists of making the best time in the different levels, the grace is that you can select the level you want to play with the girl you have chosen.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

I have repaired so many bugs to see if I can remember them all.

- Fixed the bug where you lost invincibility when rolling after taking damage.
- Fixed the bug where when you received damage and you were next to a wall you shot backwards.
- Fixed the bug where, when dying in multi player mode, only player one appeared again when selecting continue
- I do not know whether to consider it a bug but I have adjusted the distance at which the enemies move so that they move further away from the player and are not too close to attack them.

and that is all for this update, that was very great and I tried to make it happen, I hope you like it and enjoy it, see you until the next patch.

notes.title: Happy new year 2020

Hello everyone, I am very happy to have reached this year 2020 and even better that Queeny Army is already in Steam thanks to many of you, so now I want to somehow reward that great achievement and I have decided to give you ...

[h1]Queeny Army Calendar 2020[/h1]

notes.title: Update Patch V 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[b]Update patch 1.0.1[/b]

Hello Queeny Army recruits.

The game was updated to version 1.0.1

This patch contain many changes to the game to make it more enjoyable for new players also this fix many errors.

¿What's the changes? 

[b]Changes on Gameplay[/b]

-Now  on Easy and Normal mode, enemies  [b]don't deal damage by contact[/b] except [b]Brown cops[/b],[b] The Pipers[/b] (Criminals), and [b]drones[/b].

[b]Changes to interface(HUD)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031344/56499e3a46ee29361f5772ec1378c90806aabf54.jpg[/img]

-Now it show on mid/bottom the dificult level you are playing.

-Reserve weapon show in front of your main weapon icon.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

-I fix a issuise with controls when you return to main menu and it disabled the joypad.
-I add a way to get back to main menu on character selection.

I hope this changes make a better gameplay experience, If you let me know more bugs in game, please contact me on Twitter as @SirAldelink or my email aldelink@gmail.com

Kind regards.
